title: Explain this number names the measure of the clicked cell and never does arithmetic across different measures

criteria.given: a two-measure query (Unit Sales and Store Sales on the columns, Product Family on the rows) has been executed in the session
criteria.then: explaining the Store Sales cell for Food names Store Sales, and explaining the Unit Sales cell for Drink names Unit Sales — not the first column's measure

criteria.given: the same two-measure cellset, whose rows mix Unit Sales and Store Sales cells
criteria.then: no driver or narrative sentence mixes two measures: the Store Sales cell's story never names the Unit Sales figure or a row total, and the row-wise drivers are absent where the row holds only one cell of the clicked measure

steps.name: run the two-measure query the issue reproduces with

json.name: acceptance-2192
json.mdx: SELECT NON EMPTY {[Measures].[Unit Sales], [Measures].[Store Sales]} ON COLUMNS, NON EMPTY {[Product].[Products].[Product Family].Members} ON ROWS FROM [Sales]

steps.name: the Store Sales cell for Food is explained under Store Sales
the Unit Sales cell for Drink is explained under Unit Sales
the Store Sales story never mixes in the Unit Sales figure or a cross-measure row total
the Unit Sales story never mixes in the Store Sales figure or a cross-measure row total
